legacy_implied_expectations_NOT_REVALIDA.interpretation: The market price requires low-to-mid-teens revenue compounding for a decade while preserving high-20s to low-30s FCF margins. This is plausible but leaves little valuation margin of safety.

current_findings: 이용량 기반 반복매출·임상/교육 생태계·재무 생존성이 기존 정밀분석 중 가장 설득력 있다. 80점은 유지하지만 높은 기업 품질을 현재 가격의 안전마진과 동일시하지 않는다.
기존 362달러 Base는 365.56달러 기준가와 유사하다. 9.5%에서 9%로 할인율을 낮춘 비교는 가치 개선이 아니라 정책 민감도다. 환매로 희석을 상쇄하면서 환매 재원을 차감하지 않으면 현금과 주당효과를 중복 계산한다.
implied_expectations.current_model_limit: 환매 재원을 포함한 주당 현금흐름을 완성하고, 절차 성장·경쟁·리콜 위험 변화 없이 충분한 할인 또는 실적 상향이 발생하는지 확인한다.

method_changes: All three cases use US 9% discount rate and 3% terminal company-FCF growth.
Unlisted investments excluded; inherited liquid financial assets are a proxy, not all proven excess cash.
No free negative dilution. Positive dilution continues in the terminal period.
Reported-FCF compensation/repurchase/interest-income bridge is incomplete; outputs are diagnostic, not actionable fair values.

bear.note: Positive terminal dilution lowers per-share terminal growth; cash distributions and funded buybacks must still be reconciled before investment use.

base.note: Positive terminal dilution lowers per-share terminal growth; cash distributions and funded buybacks must still be reconciled before investment use.

bull.note: Positive terminal dilution lowers per-share terminal growth; cash distributions and funded buybacks must still be reconciled before investment use.

key_assumptions: U.S. procedure growth matures and international adoption slows
Competitors take placements and create pricing pressure
Hospital economics and remanufactured instruments constrain recurring revenue
FCF margin compresses as manufacturing, leasing and service costs rise
Da Vinci procedure growth gradually moderates while remaining durable
International adoption, da Vinci 5, SP and Ion extend the growth runway
Recurring revenue remains near the mid-80 percent range
Robotic assistance expands rapidly across global soft-tissue procedures
Da Vinci 5 improves pricing, utilization and consumable economics
Ion becomes a scaled interventional platform and SP expands indications
Moat strength and operating leverage sustain a low-30s FCF margin

conditions: A serious product-safety or cybersecurity event causes sustained loss of trust
Competitive systems cause major account losses and recurring-revenue pressure
Reimbursement or antitrust remedies impair procedure and instrument economics
Revenue growth falls toward low single digits and FCF margin compresses toward the high teens

notes:
2026-09-05 재심사: 상위 scenarios와 legacy_implied_expectations는 복구·보존한 과거 추정치이며 승인된 현재 가치가 아니다. 최신 판단은 re-evaluation-2026-09-05.md, 통일 허들 진단은 implied_expectations.uniform_hurdle_diagnostic(해당 종목)을 참조. 보고 FCF와 owner-FCFE의 비용·희석 브리지는 미완성이다. 총점 보류 종목의 상위 기대차/비대칭 점수도 과거 스냅샷이다.
기존 모델 메모(과거): TTM FCF equals FY2025 operating cash flow plus H1 2026 operating cash flow less H1 2025 operating cash flow, minus similarly calculated TTM capital expenditures: $3.7064B - $0.4838B = $3.2226B. Scenario values are decision-framework estimates, not price targets.
